spans.s:
अल्प अल्प, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अल्?) perhaps
connected with अर्भ), small, minute, trifling; little;
seldom, rare; of short existence. अल्पम्, ind. little;
अल्पात्, ind. without much trouble, easily; अल्पेन,
ind. easily [cf. Lith. alpstu, ap-alpstu, ‘to faint’].
—अल्प-कार्य, अम्, n. small matter.
—अल्प-केशी,
f., N. of a plant; or perhaps the root of sweet flag.
—अल्प-क्रीत, अस्, आ, अम्, bought for little money,
cheap.
—अल्प-गन्ध, अम्, n. the red lotus.
—अल्प-चेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, inert.
—अल्प-च्छद,
अस्, आ, अम्, scantily clad.
—अल्प-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्,
knowing little, ignorant, shallow, superficial.
—अल्प-
तनु, उस्, उस्, उ, small-bodied; short, thin.
—अल्प-
ता, f. or अल्प-त्व, अम्, n. smallness, minuteness;
inferiority, insignificance.
—अल्प-दक्षिण, अस्, आ,
अम्, defective in presents (as a ceremony).
—अल्प-
दृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, of confined views, narrow-minded.
—अल्प-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, of little wealth, not afflu-
ent.
—अल्प-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, weak-minded, having lit-
tle sense, foolish.
—अल्प-पत्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a
plant, a species of the Tulasi.
—अल्प-पद्म, अम्,
n. the red lotus.
—अल्प-परीवार, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a small train or retinue.
—अल्प-पशु, उस्, उस्,
उ, Ved. having a small number of cattle.
—अल्प-
पुण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, whose religious merits are small.
—अल्प-प्रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having few descendants
or few subjects.
—अल्प-प्रभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, of
little weight or consequence, insignificant.
—अल्प-
प्रभाव-त्व, अम्, n. insignificance.
—अल्प-प्र-
माण or अल्पप्रमाणक, अस्, आ, अम्, of little
weight or measure; of little authority, resting on
little evidence; (अस्), m. common cucumber, Cucu-
mis Sativus.
—अल्प-प्रयोग, अस्, आ, अम्, of rare ap-
plication or use.
—अल्प-प्राण, अस्, m. (in gram.)
slight breathing or weak aspiration; the effort in
uttering the vowels, the semivowels य्, र्, ल्, व्, the
consonants क्, च्, ट्, त्, प्, ग्, ज्, ड्, द्, ब्, and the nasals,
is said to be accompanied with slight aspiration, but
practically अल्प-प्राण is here equivalent to unas-
pirated, as opposed to महा-प्राण, q. v.; (अस्, आ,
अम्), having little or short breath, asthmatic.
—अल्प-
बल, अस्, आ, अम्, of little strength, feeble.
—अल्प-
[]
बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, causing little annoyance or incon-
venience.
—अल्प-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, weak-minded,
unwise, ignorant, silly.
—अल्प-भाग्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
having little fortune.
—अल्प-भाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speak-
ing little, taciturn.
—अल्प-मध्यम, अस्, आ, अम्,
thin-waisted.
—अल्प-मात्र, अम्, n. a little, a little
merely; a short time, a few moments.
—अल्प-मा-
रिष, अस्, m. a kind of amaranth, Amaranthus Poly-
gamus.
—अल्प-मूर्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, small-bodied, dimi-
nutive; (इस्), f. a small figure or object.
—अल्प-
मूल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of small value.
—अल्प-मेधस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, of little understanding, ignorant, silly.
—अल्पम्-पच, अस्, आ, अम्, cooking little, stingy.
—अल्प-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, young in age.
—अल्प-
वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking little, taciturn.
—अल्प-
विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, ignorant, ill-taught, uneducated.
—अल्प-विषय, अस्, आ, अम्, of limited range or
capacity, engaged in trifling matters.
—अल्पशः-
पङ्क्ति, इस्, f., N. of a metre.
—अल्प-शक्ति, इस्, इस्,
इ, of little strength, weak, feeble.
—अल्प-शस्, ind.
in a low degree, a little; separately; seldom, now
and then.
—अल्प-सरस्, अस्, n. a basin, a small
pond, one which is shallow or dry in the hot season.
—अल्प-स्नायु, उस्, उस्, उ, having few sinews.
—अल्पाकाङ्क्षिन् (˚प-आक्˚), ई, इणी, इ, desiring little,
contented or satisfied with little.
—अल्पाञ्जि (˚प-अञ्˚),
इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. covered with minute spots.
—अल्पा-
युस् (˚प-आय्˚), उस्, उस्, उस्, short-lived; young, of
few years; (उस्), m. a goat.
—अल्पारम्भ (˚प-
आर्˚), अस्, m. a gradual beginning.
—अल्पाल्प (˚प-
अल्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, very little, minute; little by little.
—अल्पाहार (˚प-आह्˚), अस्, m. the taking little
food; moderation, abstinence; (अस्, आ, अम्), absti-
nent.
—अल्पाहारिन् (˚प-आह्˚), ई, इणी, इ, eating little,
moderate, abstemious.
—अल्पेच्छु (˚प-इच्˚), उस्, उस्,
उ, moderate in wishes, seeking little.
—अल्पेतर
(˚प-इत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, large, lit. other than small.
—अल्पेशाख्य (अल्प-ईश-आख्य), अस्, आ, अम्, named
after an insignificant chief or master, of low origin.
—अल्पोन (˚प-ऊन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, slightly defective,
not quite complete or not finished.
—अल्पोपाय
(˚प-उप्˚), अस्, m. small means.

अल्पिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, least, smallest, very small.
—अल्पिष्ठ-कीर्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, of little note.

अल्पी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make
small.

अल्पी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made small; comminuted;
reduced in number.

अल्पी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become small; diminished,
reduced in number.
अल्पीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, smaller, less, very small.
